preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid node range [1, n].
The input contains exactly m edges.
The graph has n nodes and m edges, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 5e5 and n-1 ≤ m ≤ 5e5.
The input graph is a cactus (connected, no edge lies on more than one simple cycle).

postconditions.description: The output is the variance of X[S] (number of connected components after removing nodes in S) modulo 10^9+7, where S is a random subset of nodes with each node included independently with probability 1/2.
The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9+7.

invariants.description: The constant MOD is fixed as 10^9 + 7 for modular arithmetic.
